resources.string: Pocket Agent reads the screen and acts on it (taps, typing, scrolling, opening apps) only when you start a task from its bubble. What it reads is sent to the AI provider you set up. It asks before actions that may send, pay, post or delete. While no task runs it receives no screen events. It stores nothing.
Pocket Agent stopped: accessibility was turned off
Pocket Agent works through an accessibility service. Turn on Pocket Agent in the accessibility settings, then tap the bubble to give it a task.
Could not read the screen. Please try again.

1. The text on your screen, and a screenshot when the agent asks for one, is sent directly to the AI provider you choose, and nowhere else. There is no telemetry, no analytics and no Pocket Agent server.
2. Nothing from your screen is stored after a task ends.
3. While a task runs, the agent can tap and type on your phone. It asks before actions that may send, pay, post or delete, and it does not work in banking, payment, password-manager or Settings apps. This check is a rule of thumb and can miss unusual wording.
4. You can stop a running task at any time by long-pressing the bubble.
Your screen text will be sent to %1$s.

Voice input uses the speech recogniser built into your phone. On-device recognition is requested first, but the recogniser may send your audio online, to the phone maker or Google, in the cloud. Pocket Agent itself does not store or send the audio. This is optional.
Turn the microphone on in the setup screen to talk.
Tap the bubble on any screen to give Pocket Agent a task. Tap a card\'s Edit button to change a setting.
Choose who provides the AI. You bring your own key; it is stored encrypted on this phone.
Base address of an OpenAI-compatible API
API key (not needed for a local server)
Type the exact model name from your provider, then test it. The test makes one small request.
Turn on Pocket Agent in the accessibility settings. This lets it read the screen and tap for you while a task runs.
If the switch is greyed out, open the app info for Pocket Agent, open the three-dot menu and choose Allow restricted settings.
The bubble is how you start a task from any screen.
Run a small first task to see everything work. Change the text if you like.
Switch on Pocket Agent in the accessibility settings so the test can run.
